dialogues.jp: き〜んこ〜んか〜んこ〜ん。
dialogues.en: Ding dong dang dong.
dialogues.text: Ding dong dang dong.

dialogues.jp: そして、驚くほど何事もなく１日が終わった。
dialogues.en: And the day ended with no problems.
dialogues.text: And the day ended with no problems.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうでした朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "How was it, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "How was it, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.jp: ことりが笑顔で俺の席を訪れる。
dialogues.en: Kotori came to my seat, smiling.
dialogues.text: Kotori came to my seat, smiling.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、いや、別になんでもないな」
dialogues.en: "Well, it was nothing."
dialogues.text: "Well, it was nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「良かった」
dialogues.en: "Good."
dialogues.text: "Good."

dialogues.jp:
今日何度目かも分からないのに、ことりは心底
安心したと笑ってくれる。
dialogues.en:
Kotori smiled as she seems to be so relieved. I don't know
how many times she did that to me today.
dialogues.text:
Kotori smiled as she seems to be so relieved. I don't know
how many times she did that to me today.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「授業で分からないこととかあったら、なんで
　も聞いてくださいね」
dialogues.en:
"Ask me any time when you have questions about the class,
okay?"
dialogues.text:
"Ask me any time when you have questions about the class,
okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まだ、なにもしてないですよ」
dialogues.en: "I haven't done anything yet."
dialogues.text: "I haven't done anything yet."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Right."
dialogues.text: "Right."

dialogues.jp:
本当に、顔見知りも、初めて見るやつも、皆が
俺のことを気にしてくれている。
dialogues.en: Everybody I know, and I don't know, all care about me.
dialogues.text: Everybody I know, and I don't know, all care about me.

dialogues.jp:
いや、中にはあいつ誰だろうなぁ、と思ってる
やつもいるだろうけど。
dialogues.en:
I'm sure there are some people who are wondering about me as
well.
dialogues.text:
I'm sure there are some people who are wondering about me as
well.

dialogues.jp:
当たり前だけど、普通っていうものは、代わり
映えしない。
dialogues.en:
It's a natural thing, but everyday life doesn't seem to be
much different.
dialogues.text:
It's a natural thing, but everyday life doesn't seem to be
much different.

dialogues.jp:
私生活でどんな問題を抱えていようが、ここに
来ればただの一人の学生でしかないのだ。
dialogues.en:
We're all only students here at school, regardless of what
problems we all have in our private life.
dialogues.text:
We're all only students here at school, regardless of what
problems we all have in our private life.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、早く帰りたいなら席につけ」
dialogues.en: "Sit down right now, if you want to go home."
dialogues.text: "Sit down right now, if you want to go home."

dialogues.jp:
近くの教室で授業でもしてたのか、すぐに暦先
生が入ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei walked in right away. Maybe she had a class
nearby.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei walked in right away. Maybe she had a class
nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ」
dialogues.en: "Okay then..."
dialogues.text: "Okay then..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 手を振りかえして笑う。
dialogues.en: I smiled, waving back at her.
dialogues.text: I smiled, waving back at her.

dialogues.jp:
ざわざわ、と椅子と机の音が響いて、やがて静
まる。
dialogues.en:
The noise of desks and chairs echoed, and then it became
quiet.
dialogues.text:
The noise of desks and chairs echoed, and then it became
quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「特に連絡とかはないな」
dialogues.en: "Is there anything you want to let me know?"
dialogues.text: "Is there anything you want to let me know?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「これから本格的に授業が始まるし、来月には
　テストもあるから、そろそろ気を引き締めて
　いくように」
dialogues.en:
"The class is starting to get more serious, and we have a
test next month. You all need to tighten up a little."
dialogues.text:
"The class is starting to get more serious, and we have a
test next month. You all need to tighten up a little."

dialogues.jp:
一瞬目があったが、暦先生は何事もなかったか
のように横に流した。
dialogues.en:
She looked at me for a second, but she acted like nothing
has happened.
dialogues.text:
She looked at me for a second, but she acted like nothing
has happened.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、だからって無理はするなよ。それじゃ
　あ終わりにしようか」
dialogues.en: "Try not to overdo it though. So, that's it for today."
dialogues.text: "Try not to overdo it though. So, that's it for today."

dialogues.jp:
パン、と手を打ちつつ指を組んで、暦先生に促
された挨拶でＨＲが終わった。
dialogues.en:
She clapped her hand and crossed her fingers, and then we
finished the homeroom with her call.
dialogues.text:
She clapped her hand and crossed her fingers, and then we
finished the homeroom with her call.

dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ」
dialogues.en: "Phew."
dialogues.text: "Phew."

dialogues.jp:
椅子に思い切り背を預けて、盛大なため息をつ
く。
dialogues.en: I sighed as I leaned against the back of my chair.
dialogues.text: I sighed as I leaned against the back of my chair.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、この後少しは時間があるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you have any time after this?"
dialogues.text: "Do you have any time after this?"

dialogues.jp: ゆったりとした動きで杉並が俺の前にくる。
dialogues.en: Suginami came in front of me slowly.
dialogues.text: Suginami came in front of me slowly.

dialogues.jp: 「ん、どうすっかな」
dialogues.en: "Mm, I don't know."
dialogues.text: "Mm, I don't know."

dialogues.jp: 深く椅子に座りながら、時計を見つめた。
dialogues.en: I sat on the chair deeply, looking at the clock.
dialogues.text: I sat on the chair deeply, looking at the clock.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の様子が気になるところが正直だが、いか
んせん、気にすればするほど身体に悪いのだ。
dialogues.en:
I'm worried about Nemu, but it isn't good for me to be too
worried about her.
dialogues.text:
I'm worried about Nemu, but it isn't good for me to be too
worried about her.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉妹のことが気になるなら、別にお前の家
　でもいいんだが」
dialogues.en:
"I can go to your house if you're worried about your
sister."
dialogues.text:
"I can go to your house if you're worried about your
sister."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、そんなんじゃないって」
dialogues.en: "It's not like that."
dialogues.text: "It's not like that."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「他にどんなんがあるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What else could it be?"
dialogues.text: "What else could it be?"

dialogues.jp:
教室を出ずにそのまま学生が減るのを待ってい
たのか。
dialogues.en: They waited until everybody else had gone home for me?
dialogues.text: They waited until everybody else had gone home for me?

dialogues.jp: この３人というのも懐かしい組み合わせだ。
dialogues.en: I haven't been with these two for a while.
dialogues.text: I haven't been with these two for a while.

dialogues.jp: 「なにか用ですか？」
dialogues.en: "What can I do for you?"
dialogues.text: "What can I do for you?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、私的なことなんだが、音夢のやつは大
　丈夫なのか？」
dialogues.en: "It's private stuff, but is Nemu okay?"
dialogues.text: "It's private stuff, but is Nemu okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「えぇ、最近は調子がいいみたいなんで。今日
　は病院に行って検査してもらうって言ってま
　したよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. She seems to be much better lately. She said she's
going to the doctors today, for a checkup."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. She seems to be much better lately. She said she's
going to the doctors today, for a checkup."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ、そうなんだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
なんだか暦先生の反応が淡白で、ぴん、と反応
してしまう。
dialogues.en: I felt weird to see Koyomi-sensei took it lightly.
dialogues.text: I felt weird to see Koyomi-sensei took it lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだか、お前が嬉しそうじゃないんだよな」
dialogues.en: "You don't look happy."
dialogues.text: "You don't look happy."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「え、あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, yeah?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並の顔を鏡のように見て、自分の頬に触れる。
dialogues.en:
I looked at Suginami's face like a mirror, and touched my
face.
dialogues.text:
I looked at Suginami's face like a mirror, and touched my
face.

dialogues.jp:
そうか、せっかくの吉報なのに、俺が嬉しそう
ではないのでは信じられないか。
dialogues.en: Maybe they can't believe me because I don't look happy.
dialogues.text: Maybe they can't believe me because I don't look happy.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、俺のはただの春休みボケだから」
dialogues.en: "I'm just not myself yet."
dialogues.text: "I'm just not myself yet."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「分かった……無理はするなよ」
dialogues.en: "I see...... take it easy, okay?"
dialogues.text: "I see...... take it easy, okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生を見送って、俺も立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: I saw Koyomi-sensei off, and I stood up.
dialogues.text: I saw Koyomi-sensei off, and I stood up.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「行くのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you going?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「悪い杉並。今日はやっぱり駄目だわ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, Suginami. I can't go today."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, Suginami. I can't go today."

dialogues.jp: なんだか重過ぎる鞄を背負う。
dialogues.en: I picked up my bag which felt way too heavy.
dialogues.text: I picked up my bag which felt way too heavy.

dialogues.jp: 「また、でいいか？」
dialogues.en: "Can we do it another time?"
dialogues.text: "Can we do it another time?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、｛・・／また｝学園に来れればいいがな」
dialogues.en: "Well, .."if" you could come back to school."
dialogues.text: "Well, .."if" you could come back to school."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「来るよ……」
dialogues.en: "I'll come back......"
dialogues.text: "I'll come back......"

dialogues.jp: なんだか喜ばしい話題なのに、ため息が混じる。
dialogues.en: This was supposed be a happy talk, but I can't stop sighing.
dialogues.text: This was supposed be a happy talk, but I can't stop sighing.

dialogues.jp: 「来れるはずなんだよ……ふたりで」
dialogues.en: "We should be able to come...... together."
dialogues.text: "We should be able to come...... together."

dialogues.jp: ◆友達の心配◆
dialogues.en: ◆Friends worry◆
dialogues.text: ◆Friends worry◆

dialogues.jp:
授業にはついていけなかったが、そんなことで
すら、登校の時と同じで皆が心配してくれる。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't understand the class, but everybody seems to be
worried about me.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't understand the class, but everybody seems to be
worried about me.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、そんな日常に戻れたからこそ、俺は音夢
の大切さを再確認することが出来た……。
dialogues.en:
And because I was able to be back in my everyday life, it
made me realize how important Nemu is once again......
dialogues.text:
And because I was able to be back in my everyday life, it
made me realize how important Nemu is once again......
